risks.note: MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' names fluctuations in raw material prices and availability first; the SWOT lists 'Exposure to fluctuations in raw material costs' as a weakness and 'Volatility in raw material prices' as a threat. Freeze-drying converts agricultural produce, so input cost moves directly into gross margin.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and availability

risks.note: The MD&A cites seasonality of agricultural produce among its risks and the SWOT lists 'Dependence on seasonal availability of certain raw materials' as a weakness - a structural constraint on year-round plant loading and product mix.

The Company states its export-oriented operations may be affected by changes in tariffs, duties, logistics costs and regulatory requirements in overseas markets, and lists 'Changes in international trade policies and tariffs' as a threat. Exports are a stated strategic focus (approximately Rs 1.01 crore of turnover in FY 2025-26), so trade-policy shifts hit the growth vector directly.
risks.risk: Export exposure to tariffs, duties, logistics costs and overseas trade policy

risks.note: Named both in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' and as a SWOT threat, and again in the cautionary statement; the Company sells into overseas markets and is building an export platform, so realisations are FX-sensitive.

The SWOT's first weakness is that 'Freeze-drying remains a capital-intensive manufacturing process'. With two plants and a newly added freeze-drying machine, fixed costs and depreciation are carried whether or not volumes fill the added capacity.

Both the Ankleshwar and Bhatpore, Surat facilities ran at approximately 18 tons per month against installed capacity of approximately 22 tons per month, and the SWOT flags 'Greater utilisation of the new Surat manufacturing capacity' as an opportunity still to be captured. Management's own outlook makes improved capacity utilisation a condition of growth, 'subject to prevailing market conditions'.
Listed as a threat in the SWOT and among risks in the MD&A; the Company describes freeze-drying as a niche, specialised market where customers can be won on technology, quality systems and scale.
risks.risk: Competition from domestic and international players

risks.note: The SWOT weakness is 'Relatively developing domestic retail penetration', yet the stated strategy is to move from manufacturing into consumer brands (FZYEZY, OXYNXT). The MD's own message concedes that building a consumer brand 'requires patience, investment and, above all, an understanding of the consumer' - execution risk on an unproven channel.
risks.risk: Weak domestic retail penetration against a brand-led pivot
